entities.summary: Gordon Glen Kluzak is a Canadian former professional hockey player who played for the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL) from 1982 to 1991. He was selected first overall by the Bruins in the 1982 NHL Entry Draft. Kluzak was plagued with injuries for much of his career, missing two full seasons and playing a combined thirteen games over his last three seasons.
